<b>Pilby</b> (initially known as <b>Little Pilgrim</b>) is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. 

== Background ==
Pilby is one of the many pilgrims who arrived in [[Bone Bottom]] to start his pilgrimage to [[the Citadel]], found resting before setting out on his journey.<ref>Pilby: <i>"Guided by faith, we climb through flaming fields, across rolling moors, and up great gilded steps. All to reach that eternal, shining Citadel. Once I'm good and ready, I'll make the climb myself..."</i></ref><ref>Pilby: <i>"Rest here with me as long as you like. I'm not ready to leave yet, and a little company is always nice."</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
Pilby can first be found in [[Bone Bottom]] and is initially known as Little Pilgrim. After meeting [[Shakra]] for the first time, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can warn Pilby about the camp's poor condition as the lands around turn deadly, and ask why pilgrims undertake such a dangerous journey at all.<ref>Hornet and Pilby dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "This camp seems in poor condition, good bug. With the lands around turning deadly, I'd worry for its safety."<br>Pilby: "Aye. We surely aren't seeing its finest moment, but this place has been serving us passing bugs for as long as any can remember. It's faith, you see! All those pilgrims, now and past. Our devotion holds it together. The camp'll remain, and provide, no matter the troubles."</i></ref><ref>Hornet and Pilby dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "I wonder, little pilgrim. What calls you and your fellows up to the Citadel? If the way is dangerous, why take the journey at all?"<br>Pilby: "Strange question to be asking of a pilgrim. Our holy land calls on us. To journey up is our greatest task. Who are we to refuse? Guided by faith, we climb through flaming fields, across rolling moors, and up great gilded steps. All to reach that eternal, shining Citadel. Once I'm good and ready, I'll make the climb myself..."</i></ref> Pilby acknowledges the camp's troubles but insists that faith and devotion hold it together, and that journeying up to [[the Citadel]] is the pilgrims' greatest task, one they are not to refuse.

As Hornet progresses further, Pilby notices that she keeps returning to Bone Bottom, unusual behaviour for a pilgrim.<ref>Pilby: <i>"Hm? I recognise you. You've returned to the camp, then? Are you a pilgrim, or just a wanderer?"</i></ref> He uses these visits as an opportunity to ask about the world beyond the camp, confirming rumours he has heard.<ref>Pilby: <i>"Must be terrifying out there, beyond the settlement. Nothing but monsters and madness lurking in the darkness. I've heard tales of a safe place, though. Just up above here, where the moss paints the stones green, there's an old village. Bit of a holy place, apparently, well protected."</i></ref><ref>Pilby: <i>"Been hearing awful whispers in camp, about pilgrims driven mad by the hardships of the climb, crying out and attacking their fellows. You've been out there. Tell me, is it really so?"</i></ref> After Hornet visits saved [[Bellhart]], Pilby remarks that her travels have taken her far and admits he feels ashamed for tarrying so long in one place.<ref>Hornet and Pilby dialogue: <br><i>Pilby: "Your travels have taken you far, haven't they? While I'm yet to even start my journey. Shameful behaviour for a pilgrim, really, to tarry here so long." <br>Hornet: "I see no shame in it, sir. Your life is your own, and need not be squandered at the ghostly call of the Citadel. Journey out for your own sake, or not at all."<br>Pilby: "Heh... you truly aren't a pilgrim, that's for certain. That's blasphemy, spoken with friendly intentions or not. And yet... I don't recoil from what you say. Perhaps I'm not much of a pilgrim either."</i></ref> Hornet disagrees, telling him that his life is his own and need not be squandered at the ghostly call of the Citadel, and that he should journey for his own sake, or not at all. Pilby notes that while her words border on blasphemy, he does not recoil from them, and wonders whether he is truly much of a pilgrim after all.

If Hornet has had all five prior conversations with him, Pilby shares his name upon speaking again and says it has been nice spending time with her.<ref>Hornet and Pilby dialogue: <br><i>Pilby: "Never shared my name with you, did I? Awfully remiss of me. It's Pilby. Been nice spending time with you, miss." <br>Hornet: "Likewise, sir. It's been some time since I had such ample opportunity for friendly conversation. My name is Hornet. It is good to be properly acquainted at last."<br>Pilby: "Hornet, eh? Strong name, that. It certainly suits you, miss. Heh heh..."</i></ref> Hornet reciprocates, introducing herself and noting that it has been some time since she had such ample opportunity for friendly conversation. His name card, previously reading "Little Pilgrim", changes to "Pilby."

After slaying the first [[Skull Tyrant]], sitting on the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] in Bone Bottom can cause a Skull Tyrant to attack the settlement if certain conditions are met. If this occurs during [[Act 1]], Pilby is killed by the Skull Tyrant, and a funeral for him is held after the Bone Bottom bench is repaired. The [[Solemn Pilgrim]] leads the funeral, with differing dialogue depending on whether Hornet learned Pilby's name or not. If the Skull Tyrant attack does not occur before the start of [[Act 2]], Pilby leaves Bone Bottom. If Hornet had never spoken with him by that point, Pilby does not appear for the rest of the game.

Pilby arrives at [[Pilgrim's Rest]] if the following conditions are met:<ref group=code><code>GameManager.TimePasses()</code> checks various flags and sets <code>pilbyInsidePilgrimsRest</code>.</ref>
* Hornet has talked with Pilby in Bone Bottom.
* Hornet has either learned the [[Threefold Melody]] and unlocked the lift to [[the Cradle]] (without having to ascend it), or received the [[Faydown Cloak]].
* The [[Rhinogrund]] behind the gate to the east of Pilgrim's Rest is either still locked behind the gate, has been killed before the gate is opened, or the door mechanism to Pilgrim's Rest is intact.

Pilby is glad to see Hornet and eagerly tells her about everything he saw on the way,<ref>Hornet and Pilby dialogue: <br><i>Pilby: "Ah, hello again! What a blessing to see a familiar face on this treacherous climb." <br>Hornet: "Greetings, sir. I see you have begun your pilgrimage, or else set out for your own sake. Either way, I am glad to see you here unharmed."<br>Pilby: "Not quite unharmed... I've suffered my share of scrapes and burns. That's just the nature of the journey, I suppose. But I've seen so much! Great metal structures and vast scorched fields! The grandeur of it all is humbling indeed, even for one like me who was so humble to begin with."</i></ref> also sharing his name if Hornet has not learned it previously. He mentions that he will continue his pilgrimage after resting, and looks forward to what else lies ahead.<ref>Pilby: <i>"I've a long way to go, and much more to see. For now though, let's just rest a little while, eh?"</i></ref>

If the mechanism for the door to Pilgrim's Rest is broken, Pilby is found inside the building, so long as the Rhinogrund has not been released.

If Pilby is inside Pilgrim's Rest and Hornet opens the gate to release the Rhinogrund, but leaves the room before it exits, both Pilby and the Rhinogrund appear inside the building upon returning after resting on a bench in another area. The Rhinogrund can kill Pilby on contact, but since the Rhinogrund attacks the counter [[Mort]] is cowering behind until provoked by Hornet, it is possible to prevent Pilby's death and interact with him as usual.

Once seen, Pilby departs Pilgrim's Rest after Hornet rests on a bench outside the [[Far Fields]].

== Location ==
Pilby can first be found in [[Bone Bottom]], to the right of the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]]. If he is not killed by the [[Skull Tyrant]], he leaves the settlement in [[Act 2]] and can be found in [[Pilgrim's Rest]] if certain conditions are met.

== Trivia ==
* Pilby shares a design with the [[Winged Pilgrim]]s (both [[Haunting|haunted]] and not haunted) found in other areas of the game, such as the one sometimes found in front of the [[Bellway]] station in [[Bellhart]].<ref group=code>Flag <code>belltownCrowd</code> is randomised in <code>GameManager.TimePasses()</code> and controls the GameObject <code>Pilgrim Crowds</code> in <code>belltown.bundle</code>.</ref>
*According to the internal file name <code>pilgrim-cries-william.m4a</code>, Pilby was voiced by [[William Pellen]] in the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer.<ref group=code>[https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FJfFokRdBz2BnjZ-nWcCsaUnlQWSZGH_J9oPgmdkNio/edit?usp=sharing <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer full metadata]</ref> 
*Pilby can only take damage from the hurtbox of an enemy, as opposed to its hitbox. (For example, the Rhinogrund's debris cannot hit Pilby, but its body can.)
